resources.string: Try each way of using the SDK. Use a sandbox key (pk_test_…): nothing here moves real money.
This build uses a placeholder public key, so the Widget cannot start real flows. Add fintoc.publicKey=pk_test_… to local.properties and rebuild.
Movements in a Compose FintocWidget. It only needs your public key.
Payments in a Compose FintocWidget, with a session token that you paste.
The SDK asks a simulated backend for the session token, and shows loading and retry.
Pay in a screen of its own
For apps without Compose: the Activity host, opened with FintocWidgetContract.
Opens a Fintoc-hosted page in a Custom Tab and reads what comes back.
Language of the SDK\'s own texts
Only the SDK\'s loading, error and button texts change. The Widget page keeps its own language.
Your backend creates a Checkout Session with its secret key and gives you its session_token. Paste it here: the app never holds your secret key.
That does not look like a session token. It must not be blank, contain spaces or be a secret key.
Make the simulated backend fail on the first attempt
Create a Checkout Session on your backend with these addresses as success_url and cancel_url, then paste its redirect_url below.
That is not an https address on a fintoc.com subdomain.
No app on this device can open it.
An address came back, but it is not one of yours or it lacks your secret value.
Only a hint. Confirm payments with Fintoc webhooks on your backend.
